instruction: Configure PAM to use SHA512 password hashing
Configure PAM to remember last 5 passwords
Set PAM password minimum length to 14 characters
Configure PAM to lock account after 3 failed SSH logins
output: echo -e 'auth required pam_tally2.so deny=3 unlock_time=600 onerr=succeed\naccount required pam_tally2.so' >> /etc/pam.d/sshd

instruction: Configure the nsswitch.conf to check systemd for hosts
Set nsswitch to use LDAP for user/group lookups
output: echo -e 'passwd: files ldap\ngroup: files ldap\nshadow: files ldap' > /etc/nsswitch.conf

instruction: Set system-wide PATH variable in /etc/environment
Set system-wide proxy variables in /etc/environment
Set default umask for all users via profile.d
Set TMOUT for automatic logout of idle users
Set system-wide history settings in bash.bashrc
Populate /etc/skel with default config files for new users
Set hard and soft limits for a user in limits.conf
output:
echo -e 'john soft nofile 4096
john hard nofile 16384
john soft nproc 1024
john hard nproc 2048' >> /etc/security/limits.conf

instruction: Set limits for a group in limits.d directory
Set core dump limits for all users
Check current ulimit values running process
output: cat /proc/$(pgrep -u root | head -1)/limits 2>/dev/null || echo 'Process not found'

instruction: Set ulimit for the current shell session
Create /etc/nologin to prevent non-root logins
output: echo 'System is down for maintenance. Please try again later.' > /etc/nologin

instruction: Set the pre-login message in /etc/issue
Set the SSH banner message in /etc/issue.net
output: echo 'Authorized access only. All activity is monitored.' > /etc/issue.net

instruction: Set the post-login message of the day
output: echo 'Welcome to $(hostname -f). All commands are logged.' > /etc/motd
